$comment: Config-driven endpoint classification, tuned from real OrnamentsPoint (shop 32467610) captures. Etsy uses /api/v3/ajax/shop/{id}/... (singular 'shop'). '*' is a wildcard; matching is case-insensitive and substring-based; FIRST matching pattern wins, so ads patterns precede listing (promoted-listing URLs contain 'listings'). Observe new paths via the extension's discovery mode and add them here.
